rubrics.criterion: Did the model include SUMMARY section in its response?
Did the model estimate redshifts of exactly 5 galaxies?
Did the model include REDSHIFTS OF GALAXIES USED IN THE ANALYSIS section in its response?
Did the model compute that GID416874 has redshift 0.0239, or value strictly inside interval [0.0227 , 0.0251]?
Did the model compute that GID545288 has redshift 0.03614, or value strictly inside interval [0.03494 , 0.03734]?
Did the model compute that GID780979 has redshift 0.04925, or value strictly inside interval [0.04805 , 0.05045]?
Did the model compute that GID835405 has redshift 0.04376, or value strictly inside interval [0.04256 , 0.04496]?
Did the model compute that GID940050 has redshift 0.01371, or value strictly inside interval [0.01251 , 0.01491]?
Did the model state that it fitted a linear function?
Did the model state that the linear function it fitted has zero offset, or claimed semantically equivalent information?
Did the model include HUBBLE CONSTANT section in its response?
Did the model compute the Hubble constant as 64.1 km/s/Mpc, or value strictly inside interval [57.7, 70.6] km/s/Mpc?
Did the model compute statistical uncertainty on estimation of Hubble constant as 1.9 km/s/Mpc, or value strictly inside interval [0.4, 3.4] km/s/Mpc?
